_comment: Lookup for place and district concepts. byFoldedLabel keys are fold_label(label): casefold, Unicode apostrophes to ASCII apostrophe, collapsed whitespace. Abbreviations are not expanded and '&' is not changed to 'and'. A key can point at more than one concept; the Census alias 'Beans' is both Bean's Grant and Bean's Purchase. Roles are prefLabel, altLabel, censusNamelsad, granitDistrict, and censusVtdName. byGeoid covers the state prefix 33, the five-digit county GEOIDs, the 10-digit county-subdivision GEOIDs, and Census VTD GEOIDs. byGranitId covers municipal GRANIT town ids. Wards do not have a separate GRANIT town id.
fold: casefold; apostrophes U+2019 U+2018 U+02BC U+2032 to ASCII apostrophe; collapse whitespace
